notes.title: Trashcan Simulator v1.1
notes.content:
New Additions
A new mystery has been added! Along with this, a new achievement has been introduced!
If you've unlocked all previous achievements, you should notice a change in the game!

Changes
It has been made clear that there are hidden achievements, and that new features are added with the unlocking of these achievements.
The game has been optimized for better performance.


We would like to thank those who provided feedback regarding the improvements. Thank you!
Please continue to share your thoughts, suggestions, and bug reports on the author's X account or on the Steam community board.
